Best estimate with the 5–95% range for each year from 1750 to 2025, by greenhouse gas, aerosol and other agents, from Indicators of Global Climate Change 2025. Human-caused agents are counted from zero in 1750; solar and volcanic forcing are IGCC's time series, which do not start from zero in 1750.
